description: This file contains the implementation of the Opencart CMS Antispam controller class, which handles actions related to managing anti-spam keywords through listing, adding, editing, and deleting functionalities within the admin panel of OpenCart.

classes.name: Antispam
classes.description: Controller class for managing anti-spam keywords in the admin panel, providing listing, editing, creating, and deleting functionalities.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point to display the list of anti-spam keywords, handling filters, sorting, pagination, and rendering the view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the listing of anti-spam entries, responding with JSON data for API or ajax requests.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves the filtered, sorted, and paginated list of anti-spam keywords in HTML view format.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing an anti-spam keyword.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the save operation for adding or editing an anti-spam keyword, returning JSON response.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected anti-spam keywords based on user permissions.
